notes.title: The Lilliputian Runner
notes.content: The Lilliputian Runner will be free to play starting this christmas! Happy holidays! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
- In-game checkpoints added to levels.
- Minor changes made to levels to improve gameplay.
- Players will now be able to move in slow motion for additional reaction time.
- The main levels can now be completed in any order player chooses. Bonus levels can be unlocked by completing enough main levels.
